description: This PHP source file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam' which handles validation and transformations of specific name/value pairs within param tags, mainly for Flash objects. It includes logic for setting attribute values based on configuration and context, focusing on security and compatibility aspects of Flash embeds.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeParam
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming and validating name/value pairs in param tags for safe Flash object embedding, ensuring only recognized attributes are set and default values are applied based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SafeParam transform, setting up 'uri' and 'wmode' attribute definitions.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array based on predefined rules, security considerations, and configuration settings, specifically for Flash parameters.
